1|## Chapter 57 — First Elections Under the Accord
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Democracy is not a destination, but a practice — renewed with every vote cast, every voice heard."* 
     4|*Lerna Patel: "They think they're electing administrators. We know they're affirming an identity."*\
     5|
     6|The polling stations opened at 06:00 Martian local time across all major settlements — not with the fanfare of Earth-style campaigns, but with the quiet efficiency of a civilization that had been self-governing for decades. In Valles Marineris Colony, the first voters were not politicians or dignitaries, but the overnight shift workers from the atmospheric processors, their faces still smudged with regolith dust as they showed their identification tokens at the check-in stations.
     7|
